title: Lord Yelinak (Seasonal)
summary: Read Yelinak's storm warnings, shelter during his shield and survive increasingly fast ground mechanics.
overview: Read Yelinak's storm warnings, shelter during his shield and survive increasingly fast ground mechanics.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Move to the marked boundaries rather than following a moving tank.
Finish or cancel spells before Silence resolves.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Ground warnings give eight seconds: leave the marked 32-range storm strike, shelter within the marked 65-range storm eye, or stop casting for Silence.
At 65% health, Yelinak becomes protected for a fixed storm-shield sequence. Gather within 60 range, then move beyond the inner 35-range ring when warned.
The shield ends after 23 seconds. At 30% and 10% health, ground mechanics accelerate.
